name: displays
title: Displays
description: Every display with its mode and brightness; resolution and HiDPI scaling, rotation, mirroring and the main display through displayplacer; brightness, contrast, volume and the input source of an external monitor over DDC; arrangement presets.
author: pal

settings.label: Brightness step
settings.description: What one press of the arrow keys, a scroll on the bar item or a `+10`-style link moves a level by, in percent. Shift with an arrow always moves 1%.

settings.label: Display on the bar
settings.description: Whose brightness the bar item shows: the first external display (the built-in one has keys of its own), the main display, or the built-in one.

settings.label: LG input codes
settings.text: Use the alternate DDC input addressing (LG and some others)
settings.description: Most monitors take the standard VCP 60 codes for their inputs (DisplayPort 1 is 15, HDMI 1 is 17). LG's take 208 and 144 instead; turn this on if switching the input does nothing.

store.tagline: Resolution, brightness, rotation, mirroring and input source, plus arrangement presets
features: One row per display: its name, the mode it is in (resolution, refresh rate, HiDPI), rotation, main and mirror tags, the brightness as the accessory

Enter drills into the display: Brightness, Contrast and Volume as sliders with keys, the input source, every mode it can take (a confirm when the resolution changes, with Undo one row away), rotation, mirroring, Make main
Arrangement presets: save the current arrangement under a name, apply it from the palette, the bar or `pal://displays/preset?name=`

The built-in display through the `brightness` CLI, external monitors over DDC/CI (`m1ddc` on Apple Silicon, `ddcctl` on Intel, `ddcutil` on Linux); modes and arrangement through `displayplacer`; each optional, with a row that says what to install
A bar item with the external display's brightness, its popover a slider per display

actions.title: Open
actions.description: Drills into the display: its controls, modes and arrangement.

actions.title: Set brightness
actions.description: The percent typed in the bar (or +10 / -10).

actions.title: Make main
actions.description: Moves the arrangement so this display is at (0,0).

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: The external display's brightness (or the main or built-in one's, by the setting), with a slider per display in the popover, a scroll on the item moving it by the step. Hidden while only the built-in display is there, whose keys already set it, and while nothing installed can set any display: its rules, which Settings > Bar lets you turn off to keep the item.

empty.tooltip: DELL U2720Q: install m1ddc to set its brightness

keys.title: Brightness down / up by the step

rules.description: Only the built-in display: its keyboard keys set it. Off, and the item stays with the built-in display's level.
Nothing installed can set any display's brightness: nothing to open a slider on.
